annotations.title: Where an aircraft is right now, by callsign, hex address or tail number (paid, x402)

description: PAID: look up a flight: where an aircraft is now (position, altitude, speed, track) by callsign, ICAO24 hex or tail number, $0.0100. Data: adsb.lol community ADS-B feed, ODbL 1.0. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

ident.description: One aircraft identifier: a callsign (UAL1), a 6-hex ICAO24 address (a0b1c2) or a registration (N12345, D-ABCD). Prefix cs:, hex: or reg: to say which kind it is -- unprefixed, a 6-hex-looking string is read as a CALLSIGN. Lowercase is fine.
